functions.name: sub_020915F0
functions.signature_guess: void sub_020915F0(int unused, enum HeapID heapId)
functions.notes: r0 (param 0) is never read — caller sub_02091634 passes args[2] (word at args+8) in r0, so keep a dummy first param. Saves r1 in r4 and passes it to ov13_0221BA00(enum HeapID). Ends with OS_ResetSystem(0) then pop {r4,pc} — write OS_ResetSystem(0) as a plain call (compiler doesn't know it's noreturn). Param 0 could be void* depending on args struct; type only matters for caller codegen inside this same file, int or void* both load with plain ldr.

OS_ResetSystem.header: NitroSDK (nitro/os) — available via global.h; used freely in src/main.c, src/error_message_reset.c etc.

risks: Tail-call wrappers: all six Load/Unload functions must compile to ldr r3,=target; bx r3 — declare them void with literal args so MWCC tail-calls; forward argument types exactly (FSOverlayID and PMOverlayLoadType enum literal, no narrowing)
FS_OVERLAY_ID(OVY_0/OVY_13/OVY_38) pool constants come from the overlay table — use the FS_OVERLAY_ID macro (the asm .inc includes <nitro/fs/overlay.h>), matching existing C usage like src/scrcmd_c.c

include/unk_020915B0.h already exists with LoadDwcOverlay/UnloadDwcOverlay declared and is included by already-matched src/overlay_44_0222CDAC.c — append LoadOVY13/UnloadOVY13/LoadOVY38/UnloadOVY38/sub_020915F0/sub_02091634 without changing the existing two prototypes (IPA: header edits can perturb codegen of matched files; appending new decls is normally safe but verify overlay_44_0222CDAC.o is unchanged)
mov r1, #2 is OVY_LOAD_ASYNC (not OVY_LOAD_NORMAL) per the PMOverlayLoadType enum in include/poke_overlay.h
rodata template must be emitted after the functions (single const struct, order trivially correct); declare it const OverlayManagerTemplate to match main_menu.c's extern
sub_020915F0's first parameter is dead but ABI-load-bearing — sub_02091634 loads args+8 into r0 before the call; dropping the param changes the caller's codegen
OS_ResetSystem(0) followed by more code/return — do not mark noreturn; the asm keeps the pop {r4,pc} epilogue and 'mov r0, #1' after the call in sub_02091634
notes: Small, self-contained main-menu 'Nintendo WFC Setup' launcher: loads DWC overlay (OVY_0) + OVY_13, runs ov13_0221BA00 with heap 0x30 (0x41000 bytes under parent heap 3), then resets the system. LoadOVY38/UnloadOVY38 are exports used only by still-asm callers (overlay_45/72/75, unk_02037C94, unk_020192D0). No .data/.bss, no save_arrays.c DECL_CHUNK_EX involvement, no jump tables. Function order in C must be: LoadDwcOverlay, UnloadDwcOverlay, LoadOVY13, UnloadOVY13, sub_020915F0, LoadOVY38, UnloadOVY38, sub_02091634, then the rodata template. Key headers: include/unk_020915B0.h, include/overlay_manager.h, include/poke_overlay.h; consumer src/application/main_menu/main_menu.c.
